test_title: PYST 42: SSC CPO - English Comprehension (Held on 11 Nov 2022 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
Select the most appropriate meaning of the underlined segment in the given sentence.

Vishnu was a naughty little boy, but I couldn't help __having a soft spot for him.__

options.text: getting on extremely well with someone
doing something good for someone you have done something bad to in the past
feeling a lot of affection for one particular person, often without knowing why

solution:
The correct answer is Feeling a lot of affection for one particular person, often without knowing why.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

 
• The most appropriate meaning of the segment 'having a soft spot for him' is 'feeling a lot of affection for one particular person, often without knowing why'.
 
• Having a soft spot for him: **To feel that you like someone very much**.
 
 
• *Example: She'd always had a soft spot for her younger nephew.*
 
 
 
• Thus option 4 is the correct answer.
